title: Chapter 345 Changing Back
content:
Chapter 345 Changing Back

"Hey, Lao Jiang, didn't I say I'll go see you tomorrow? Why did I call again? I'm very busy, okay?"

A voice came from the other side of the phone soon.

Jiang Guowei heard the other party's tone of joking, but he was in no mood to joke now.

"Old Li, it's not me who bothered you. I'm really worried."

After a moment.

The other side of the phone was silent for a moment.

"Okay, there's no trouble. I'll call that old guy and he should give me my face."

"Okay, please trouble you."

After hanging up the phone, Jiang Guowei breathed a sigh of relief and slowly sat back on the sofa.

"Grandpa, will you have something wrong with Brother Sheng?"

At this time, Jiang Xiaoxiao sat next to Mr. Jiang and held his arm worriedly.

Mr. Jiang smiled and stroked Jiang Xiaoxiao's head, "Although that guy Old Li is a little bit stupid, he is definitely efficient in doing things."

"Wait, your brother will probably come back later."

He also knew about Jiang Xiaoxiao's affairs.

It's just a small fight between young people.

But Mr. Jiang was still a little angry about Lin Xu's actions of the Lin family.

It's just a pity that he is old now and is useless.

On the other side.

A young man ran into the Lin family in a hurry.

"Young Master Lin Xu, you are back."

A security guard said in fear.

"What happened at home? Why did the old man get so angry?"

This was the first time he saw his grandfather get so angry at him.

He was frightened after hanging up the phone.

The security guard was about to explain.

A girl in a long skirt trotted over in a panic.

"elder brother!"

"Sister, where is grandpa?"

Seeing the face of his sister Lin Wennuan, Lin Xu's heart suddenly rose to his throat.

At this moment, he had a bad premonition.

I recalled what I had done recently. Hiss, it seemed that there was nothing worth it to make the old man so angry.

"Brother, what have you done? Why did you mess with such a powerful person?"

Lin Wennuan looked at Lin Xu with resentment, her face feeling very aggrieved.

Lin Xu quickly raised his hands and wandered around desperately, "Sister, you have to believe me, what am I really doing?"

"Hmph, you're still quibbling, everyone has come to you!"

"What!"

This time, Lin Xu was completely panicked.

If my grandfather asks him to come back, he must be someone who even my grandfather can't handle it.

Isn’t this looking for shit when I come back?

For a moment, Lin Xu had the idea of running away immediately.

And at this moment, in the distance, an old man in a commoner slowly walked towards this place.

A slightly heavy voice sounded from his mouth.

"Lin Xu, come in with me, your grandfather is already waiting for you."

Hearing this, Lin Xu's face suddenly became miserable.

"Grandpa Ma, don't scare me."

However, Mr. Ma just patted Lin Xu on the shoulder and sighed helplessly.

"This time, you've hit the nail on the head."

No, it should be steel plate.

This was the first time he saw that kind of existence. Just a look can make him unable to move. If the other party wants to kill him, it may be just a matter of thought.

It's not on the same level at all.

Immediately, Ma Ye directly pulled Lin Xu, who was almost scared, and walked into the villa.

And at this time in the villa.

Lu Daosheng sat on the sofa, quietly savoring the good tea that the head of the Lin family treasured for many years, without any expression on his face.

At this time, Lin Ye on the other side suddenly turned his head and looked outside, and an angry look suddenly appeared on his face.

"This bastard is finally back!"

"Mr. Lu, wait a moment, I'll teach this kid a lesson."

Before Lu Daosheng could reply, Lin Ye limped towards Lin Xu with a crutch.

"Grandpa, I,"

Seeing his grandfather, Lin Xu had not finished speaking, but he had a crutch.

"Ouch! Grandpa, it hurts, it hurts!!"

"You bastard still knows how painful it is. You know that you are causing trouble outside all day long. I won't beat you to death today!"

Lin Xu felt pain and wanted to run away, but Ma Ma was silent and tightly pulled him tightly. No matter how he broke free, Ma Ma still remained motionless.

Seeing that he couldn't run away, Lin Xu immediately knelt down with a sad face, "Grandpa, I was wrong, don't beat me."

At this moment, Lin Xu's tears were falling, and Lin Ye felt a little embarrassed in his eyes.

But when Lin Ye became cruel when he thought of Lu Daosheng behind him.

Being beaten to death by yourself is better than being beaten to death by others.

Immediately, Forestry continued to waving the crutches in his hand.

For a moment, screams kept coming from inside the house.

Outside the house, Lin Wennuan had already been so scared that she sat on the ground and cried helplessly.

I don't know how long it took.

finally.

Lu Daosheng spoke.

"Stop."

This sound was like a sound of nature in Lin Xu's ears, so pleasant.

And forestry also stopped immediately.

"Mr. Lu?"

Taking advantage of this skill, Lin Xu looked up at the sofa with difficulty.

He wanted to know which expert he had provoked.

But when he saw Lu Daosheng, he was puzzled.

Which one?

Are you sure you didn’t recognize the wrong person?

At this time, Forestry carefully returned to the sofa.

Mr. Ma pulled the trembling Lin Xu and followed Lin Ye slowly.

"Baby, apologize to Mr. Lu immediately!"

"Mr. Lu, I'm sorry, forgive me."

Lin Xu was very obedient and immediately knelt down to Lu Daosheng for forgiveness.

As for the reason, it doesn't matter anymore.

Anyway, just don't beat him to death.

He could see that if the man in front of him who seemed to be only a little older than him would kill him, his grandfather would not protect him.

It sounds ridiculous, but he thinks it's the truth.

Looking at Lin Xu who was apologizing in front of him, Lu Daosheng slowly spoke, "You should be curious about who I am, right?"

Lin Xu was slightly stunned.

He was indeed curious, but he dared not say it.

And Lu Daosheng said directly: "I am Jiang Xiaoxiao's brother."

Jiang Xiaoxiao!

Lin Xu's pupils dilated, and he was shocked.

Suddenly, he understood everything.

The relationship was because of my own affairs with Jiang Xiaoxiao, and the other party came to him.

But he was sad inside.

Apart from coercion and inducement, I did nothing too much.

I thought so in my heart, but I immediately said, "Don't worry, Mr. Lu, I will never disturb Miss Jiang again in the future!"

"There is also the Jiang family's property, you will return it immediately!"

Forestry added from the side.

"Yes, yes, I'll pay it back when I go back."

But at this time, Lu Daosheng shook his head and said, "You have acquired the Jiang family's property reasonably and legally. If you didn't have that money at the beginning, the old man would not be able to hold on to it now."

Hearing this, Lin Ye smiled and said, "Mr. Lu, then this is what my Lin family wants to the Jiang family. It will not be too late to come back one day when the Jiang family rises."

This is an opportunity, and forestry also has its own little thoughts.
